# Representative ADMX/ADML corpus

Synthetic fixtures that model general production Group Policy patterns for
Plan 022 WP-1 acceptance testing.

See `docs/corpus-topology-redaction.md` for the redaction guidelines that keep
these fixtures representative rather than structural clones of any real estate.

Each `.admx` file is paired with a matching `.adml` file that carries display
strings and `presentationTable` controls, matching the shape of real central-store
templates.
